**Mode collapse means different random inputs lead to too few kinds of output.** A generator might repeatedly produce one convincing digit while ignoring the others. Sample sharpness can look good even though distribution coverage is poor. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.00028) [2](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/)

In the original saturating GAN loss, a discriminator that easily rejects generated samples can produce weak generator gradients through its saturated probability. The common non-saturating loss improves that gradient behavior but does not remove every source of collapse.

**WGAN changes the comparison signal.** A real-valued Lipschitz critic estimates a Wasserstein-style discrepancy, giving a transport-related objective that can remain informative when real and generated supports are separated. Gradient penalty encourages the required smoothness on sampled interpolations.

The penalty is not a global proof that the critic is exactly Lipschitz, and optimization can still fail. Track diversity and coverage alongside visual quality and critic losses. A better-behaved objective is useful, but it does not turn adversarial training into a guaranteed globally convergent procedure.

**Technical details and references.**

Mode collapse occurs when many latent inputs produce only a few outputs, omitting real-data modes. With the original saturating generator loss $\log(1-D(G(z)))$, a discriminator that confidently separates generated data can provide weak gradients through its saturated probability. The common non-saturating generator loss helps this issue but does not eliminate collapse. [1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.00028) [2](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/)

WGAN uses a real-valued 1-Lipschitz critic to estimate Wasserstein distance, which can supply useful transport-related gradients even for separated supports. WGAN-GP penalizes $(\|\nabla_{\hat x}f(\hat x)\|_2-1)^2$ on interpolated samples to encourage the constraint. This sampled penalty is not a global proof of Lipschitzness, and training still needs optimization and capacity control. Report diversity/coverage and training stability rather than claiming the method universally fixes every GAN failure.
